gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-noto-sans-osage: Puffy and playful, Fuzzy Bubbles looks like round letters bent from wire, while Noto Sans Osage fills its lines with inflated bowls and sweeping curves. Give the sans-serif body a generous size.

gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-noto-sans-palmyr: Fuzzy Bubbles draws its relaxed, rounded letters like bent tubing, a handwritten voice that loves a big moment. But Noto Sans Palmyrene does the quieter work, with curves that stop short and compressed ascenders keeping text tidy.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-noto-sans-pau-ci: Open-ended curves with room to breathe and a short step from lowercase top to capital top define Noto Sans Pau Cin Hau, a modern sans. Paragraphs in it feel easy.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-noto-sans-phagsp: Fuzzy Bubbles is handwritten but built like rod stock, with horizontals and verticals of identical thickness and a relaxed, personal feel. Noto Sans PhagsPa sits beneath, a see-through sans.
